name: Cortex
description: Persistent memory and typed cognition for OpenClaw agents. Knowledge survives across sessions: recall past decisions, track evolving beliefs, detect contradictions, and build a knowledge graph over time. 60 tools over MCP, running locally on SQLite and Ollama.

sqlitePath.description: Absolute path to the cortex SQLite store. Leave unset to use the engine default. Point this at an existing store to attach to memory you already have - an empty or wrong path yields a store that answers every query with zero results and looks healthy rather than misconfigured.

ollamaUrl.description: Ollama endpoint used for embeddings and the local LLM. Cortex probes this over HTTP; a process holding the port without answering counts as down.

nliUrl.description: Optional NLI service for contradiction adjudication. Without it, contradict() falls back to the LLM, which is slower and less decisive.

namespace.description: Memory namespace. Separate namespaces keep unrelated agents from reading each other's memories.
